overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating multilingual factuality of long-form biography generation using FActScore metric. Human evaluation was conducted with native speakers for ground truth annotation. LLMs were used both as generators and evaluators (fact extraction and scoring). The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent naming.
